The '''Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall''' was a building located in [[Headquarters]] on [[Verkuyl]] that housed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]]. The building may have been designed and built by [[Corlin Quarle Deld]] as his [[Daven Quarle|grandson]] knew many of the buildings secret passages. The Governor's office was on the tenth floor and guests would reside on the fifth.
